column5: The modified median petal of the orchid flower, often highly differentiated in form, colour or ornamentation, typically serving as the principal pollinator-landing platform.
column6: Curated Orchid Continuum lexicon fixture; definition drafted for testing 2026-10-11

column5: A thickened aerial stem internode of sympodial orchids that stores water and assimilates; anatomically distinct from a corm or tuber.
column6: Curated Orchid Continuum lexicon fixture; definition drafted for testing 2026-10-11

column5: A coherent mass of pollen grains transported as a unit during orchid pollination, often with accessory structures (caudicle, stipe, viscidium).
column6: Curated Orchid Continuum lexicon fixture; definition drafted for testing 2026-10-11

column5: A modified stigma lobe of most orchids that separates the pollinarium from the receptive stigma and frequently bears the viscidium.
column6: Curated Orchid Continuum lexicon fixture; definition drafted for testing 2026-10-11

column5: The sticky pad of the pollinarium that adheres to a pollinator on contact.
column6: Curated Orchid Continuum lexicon fixture; definition drafted for testing 2026-10-11

column5: A spongy multilayered epidermal sheath covering the aerial roots of many epiphytic orchids, involved in water uptake and protection.
column6: Curated Orchid Continuum lexicon fixture; definition drafted for testing 2026-10-11

column5: The developmental torsion of the orchid pedicel or ovary, commonly about 180 degrees, that positions the labellum lowermost in the open flower.
column6: Curated Orchid Continuum lexicon fixture; definition drafted for testing 2026-10-11

column5: A hollow outgrowth of a perianth segment (in orchids usually the labellum) that may contain nectar.
column6: Curated Orchid Continuum lexicon fixture; definition drafted for testing 2026-10-11

column5: The fused androecium and gynoecium of the orchid flower forming a single central structure.
column6: Curated Orchid Continuum lexicon fixture; definition drafted for testing 2026-10-11

column5: A sterile, often showy stamen-derived structure; conspicuous in slipper orchids where it covers the stigma.
column6: Curated Orchid Continuum lexicon fixture; definition drafted for testing 2026-10-11

column5: A plant that obtains carbon through a fungal partner rather than by photosynthesis, typically lacking chlorophyll.
column6: Curated Orchid Continuum lexicon fixture; definition drafted for testing 2026-10-11

column5: Self-pollination within flowers that do not open.
column6: Curated Orchid Continuum lexicon fixture; definition drafted for testing 2026-10-11

column5: The principal photosynthetic organ of the orchid plant; reduced or absent in some mycoheterotrophic lineages.
column6: Curated Orchid Continuum lexicon fixture; definition drafted for testing 2026-10-11

column5: A horizontal, usually underground stem bearing roots and shoots; the sympodial axis of many orchids.
column6: Curated Orchid Continuum lexicon fixture; definition drafted for testing 2026-10-11

column5: The flower-bearing axis of the plant, including its branching pattern and bracts.
